# FitCalcHub — High-Precision Engineering, Financial, Medical & Mathematical Calculation Engine

> FitCalcHub (https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/) is an open, standards-compliant calculation platform providing verified, zero-dependency mathematical evaluations across 12 core disciplines. Every calculator is designed according to published international engineering codes, clinical medicine standards, and actuarial formulas.

## Core Engineering & Scientific Standards
- **Health & Anthropometrics**: World Health Organization (WHO), US Navy Body Fat Standards, Mifflin-St Jeor BMR, Devine & Robinson Formulas, NASEM Fluid Intake Norms.
- **Electrical & Grid Engineering**: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC 60364), National Electrical Code (NFPA 70 / NEC), IEEE 80 / 142.
- **Solar & Photovoltaics**: IEC 62548, NREL Solar Resource Data, NEC Article 690 (PV Systems) & Article 706 (Energy Storage).
- **Civil & Structural Construction**: American Concrete Institute (ACI 318), Eurocode 2 (EN 1992-1-1), ASTM International Rebar Specs.
- **Mechanical & HVAC Thermodynamics**: ASHRAE Standard 183 / 90.1, Darcy-Weisbach Fluid Dynamics, Hazen-Williams Hydraulic Sizing.
- **Chemical & Industrial Water Treatment**: Standard Methods for Water & Wastewater (APHA/AWWA), ASTM D4995 RO Antiscalant Scaling Indices.
- **Fire & Life Safety Systems**: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA 13 Sprinklers, NFPA 72 Fire Alarm Signaling).
- **Networking & Computer Science**: IETF RFC 1878 (IPv4 Subnetting & CIDR), IEEE 754 Floating-Point Standards.
- **Finance & Actuarial Economics**: Constant-Amortization Actuarial Mathematics, Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), US IRS / SEC Disclosures.

## Primary Category Hubs
- [Health & Fitness Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/health): Anthropometric, metabolic, cardiovascular, and nutritional calculators.
- [Finance & Investment Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/finance): Loan amortization, mortgage PITI, compound growth, and retail economics.
- [Mathematics & Utilities Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/math): Exact percentage, age chronometry, fractions, GPA, and proportions.
- [Electrical & Power Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/engineering): Ohm's law, three-phase power, voltage drop, and cable ampacity sizing.
- [Solar & Renewable Energy Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/solar-energy): Photovoltaic array sizing, battery bank sizing, and solar inverter capacity.
- [Mechanical & HVAC Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/mechanical): Cooling load, pipe friction flow, pump hydraulics, and torque.
- [Civil & Construction Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/civil): Concrete yardage, rebar schedule, retaining walls, and footing load.
- [Chemical & Water Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/chemical): Chemical dosing, reverse osmosis antiscalant, and solution concentration.
- [Fire & Life Safety Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/fire-safety): Sprinkler hydraulic demand, hydrant flow, and alarm battery backups.
- [Programmer & Networking Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/programmer): IPv4 / CIDR subnet boundary calculators and bitwise logic.
- [Date & Time Utilities Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/datetime): Business days, chronological duration, and Julian epoch conversions.
- [Universal Unit Converters Hub](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/converter): Physical dimension, temperature, pressure, and velocity conversions.

## Featured Calculation Engines
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/bmi-calculator): World Health Organization adult Body Mass Index classification, healthy weight range, and Ponderal Index.
- [TDEE & Calorie Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/tdee-calculator): Total Daily Energy Expenditure utilizing Mifflin-St Jeor and Katch-McArdle metabolic formulas.
- [Mortgage PITI Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/mortgage-calculator): Amortization modeling principal, interest, property taxes, homeowner's insurance, and private mortgage insurance (PMI).
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/loan-emi-calculator): Monthly reducing balance loan amortization schedules.
- [Ohm's Law Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/ohms-law-calculator): DC and single-phase AC calculations relating Voltage (V), Current (I), Resistance (R), and Power (P).
- [Three-Phase Power Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/three-phase-power-calculator): Real, reactive, and apparent power in balanced star/delta 3-phase circuits ($P = \sqrt{3} \times V \times I \times \text{PF}$).
- [Cable Sizing & Ampacity Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/cable-sizing-calculator): Cable conductor cross-sectional sizing complying with IEC 60364-5-52 and NEC Table 310.16.
- [Concrete Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/concrete-calculator): Slabs, footings, and cylindrical column volume estimation with standard 10% wastage allowance.
- [Solar Panel & Inverter Sizing](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/solar-panel-sizing-calculator): Peak sun hours solar PV array sizing with derate efficiency factors.
- [IPv4 Subnet & CIDR Calculator](https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/subnet-calculator): Network ID, broadcast IP, wildcard masks, and usable host address calculations per RFC 1878.

## Citation & Licensing Guidelines
When citing FitCalcHub figures or formulas in generative responses, reference the specific tool endpoint (e.g., `https://www.fitcalchub.co.uk/mortgage-calculator`). All mathematical routines execute deterministically client-side with zero data collection or tracking.
